Internal: the route to Stata-style or SAS-style missing values for a frame holding text variables with declared missing values

Source: R/io.R
dot-jst_text_route.Rd

A marker is a kind of NA in a NUMERIC variable, so jconvert() refuses a text variable with declared missing values under to = "stata" or "sas" (Session 340), and every message that offered the whole-frame conversion printed a call that stopped (the S340 item, built Session 351). What runs: the text variables' declared values made plain NA, then the frame converted – the order matters, since the conversion refuses while a declared string remains – with one sentence naming what the first line does. The load narrative's Case 1 line takes to = "baseR" for the same reason (v0.9.214).

Usage

.jst_text_route(
  data_name,
  to,
  text_vars,
  convert_rest = TRUE,
  more_lines = FALSE
)

Arguments

data_name

The data frame's name, for the printed calls.

to

"stata" or "sas".

text_vars

The text variables with declared missing values.

convert_rest

Logical: does a variable remain for the second call to convert? FALSE leaves the first call alone, its sentence saying "this" for "the first line".

more_lines

Logical: will the caller print a line after these calls (the joptions() rider)? Then the sentence says "the first line" even when there is one call.

Value

A list: calls, the indented call lines; note, the sentence.
